Update to Oct 19 23:59 UTC — first day with the new telltales live

Working: verified share dropped after the Oct 19 telltales went live

  • Roblox Signup (Key 2), ends-te + device-param-spoofing: ~1% verified all day Oct 19 (was 19% on Oct 18), even though volume stayed high (up to 28k/h at 13h UTC).
  • WBD Account Lookup (Key 20), live pagebio TT: 562k on Oct 19 at ~0% verified (23% on Oct 18).
  • WBD Login (Key 8): 50k burst at 11h UTC on Oct 19, 1% verified (39% on Oct 18).
  • Adobe ARP FF (Key 8): still 60-90% verified through the morning (85k-96k/h at 01-02h UTC), then fell to ~5% verified by 23h UTC. Something was changed late on Oct 19. Confirm it holds today.

Still getting through

  • Uber SMS (Key 1): a new burst on the live TT and grease at 14-20h UTC on Oct 19 (15-21k/h), 50-99% verified. Uber SMS needs pressure on the live TT and grease combos.
  • Wells Fargo Login (Key 1), di-dict3: 2-3k/h all afternoon, ~75% verified (steady since Oct 15).
  • Adobe Sign-in (Key 5): the grease combo jumped to 5k/h at 08-09h and 15h UTC; verified share varies from 6% to 99%.

New signals found today (not created yet: see the highlighted table below)

  • di-dict-7 + di-short-300 + DI high-risk signature: recurring on Roblox Signup and Roblox Login since Oct 1 (93k on Oct 19, 0% verified).
  • sec-ch-ua/webgl RFC violation + device-param-spoofing: recurring on Uber SMS (Oct 9-11, Oct 14, Oct 16-18, mostly verified). New on Roblox Signup on Oct 19 (186k, 1% verified).
  • AppleOS impersonation + device-param-spoofing + sec-fetch-dest: new on Oct 18-19 on WBD Account Lookup (714k) and Olo Payments (105k), 0% verified. Already covered by the live TT, so on hold.
  • Not an attack: g-browser-automation-basic-render, g-browser-automation-swiftshader and g-spoofing-webgl-dimensions appeared on Oct 19 on 23-41 keys at once from a zero baseline. That looks like a new detection rollout. Check with the owners before using them.
  • The Uber UA-spoof combo on watch (g-spoofing-user-agent + g-di-bad-signature-list-match + g-device-parameter-spoofing) is gone on Oct 19, so it's dropped.

Appendix — how these were found

Weekend re-run, 2026-10-19 01:30 UTC. Step 1: 40 single flags or global TTs had >=3 keys spiking. Dropped as already known: the g-ip-datacenter / hosting / shared-egress / connection-type-velocity family and g-ip-asn-reputation-high-risk-with-session-signal (artifacts excluded on Oct 14-15). Most of the rest are the parts of attacks already tracked here, on keys already charted. Examples: g-pagebio-null-...-rfc-ct-before-cl (live TT) on 11 keys, led by Adobe ARP, WBD Account Lookup and WBD Login. di-short-300 / ja4-dict-1 / g-di-dict-1-5x on GitLab, Adobe Commerce and WBD Multi-Tenant. cdn-header-order-does-not-contain-origin / header-ua-ua-mismatch / g-operating-system-spoofing on WBD Account Lookup and GitLab, i.e. the same sessions. g--e-ja4-global-cluster-strict: Pinterest ~1.2M/day from a zero baseline, high verified, same as the Pinterest client change seen on Oct 14-16. Not an attack. One new candidate: g-spoofing-user-agent + g-di-bad-signature-list-match + g-device-parameter-spoofing on Uber SMS only (~30-55k on Oct 18, ~30-50% verified, ~0 before Oct 17). It is a single key and a single day so far, overlapping the Oct 18 06h Uber ja4-dict1 burst, so it is watched, not proposed. No new key beyond those charted reached the burst bar. Steady 0%-verified streams: Blizzard ROW Support (~15k/day on the grease + di-dict3 combos) and Bumble SMS (~10k/day on the live TT) are already blocked.
